author: TeIq
content: Delivered: backend handler now routes through submit_action_with_report when report_id is Some — SELECT FOR UPDATE on reports row, returns existing action if actioned_at populated (200), else insert via new PgActionRepo::insert_in_tx + UPDATE reports.actioned_at/actioned_by_action_id atomically (201). PgReportRepo::list_by_subject filters actioned_at IS NULL. New tests/report_action_idempotency.rs proves all four assertions. sqlx cache refreshed against live DB. Live verification: 2 POSTs of same body+report_id returned same action_id (201 then 200), exactly 1 actions row, reports.actioned_at populated, case-view reports[] now empty.
